what: On first open, a mark (bird/logo) enters the center of a contrast stage-color curtain from off-screen right in 1s easeOutCubic and stops. After a minimum of 4s and once the document has fully loaded, the mark exits off-screen left in 1s easeInOutCubic, and .5s later the curtain lifts from the right edge toward the left in 1.2s easeInOutQuart (clip-path inset 0 100% 0 0). fx:open fires as the lift begins and fx:done when it is fully lifted — only the first time in the same tab

options.in: Duration for the marker to come in (seconds), default 1 — phone original .8
options.out: Seconds for the marker to fade out, default 1 — phone original .6
options.wipe: Duration (s) of the curtain lifting, default 1.2 — phone original 1
options.gap: Seconds from when the mark starts to fall away until the veil lifts, default .5 (default length of the original’s empty tween)
options.min: Minimum time (seconds) to hold the curtain, default 4 — shorten it for screens opened often, like apps
options.once: If always, it shows every time it opens (the default is once per tab — sessionStorage)
options.key: sessionStorage name recording whether it has been shown once, default fx-pass-wipe-loader
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (If present) passing marker — if absent, only the curtain lifts after the minimum time
options.fx:open · fx:done: Events the element emits when the curtain starts to withdraw · when fully withdrawn — hang the hero logo fly-in on fx:open

note: The original is an animated flapping pigeon GIF. The flapping inside the marker is drawn by the consumer (the demo folds and spreads the wings with CSS). With reduced motion or an already-seen tab, the curtain is hidden and fx:open and fx:done fire immediately

from.where: index.html .ky-loading — original t-home__loading: black curtain · dove GIF 5.5rem · MIN_WAIT 4000 · clip-path 1.2s easeInOutQuart (phone 1s) · dove enters 1s easeOutCubic (phone .8) · exits 1s easeInOutCubic (phone .6)
